attributes.body:
Beacon acquires 314 Capital to expand into startup credit.

Brazilian wealth management platform Beacon acquired asset manager 314 Capital, founded in 2023 by Natan Epstein. The companies did not disclose the terms of the transaction.

Beacon provides wealth management services to technology founders, combining investment management with legal and tax support. Through its Equity Pools, founders can contribute shares in their companies in exchange for exposure to other companies in the portfolio.

The acquisition marks Beacon's entry into credit. Beacon plans to launch a credit rights investment fund, known in Brazil as a FIDC, in 2026 to finance startups in its network.

Beacon's two Equity Pools include more than 200 founders and approximately $27.3M in equity stakes. Its network includes Omie, Blip, Flash, Onfly, NG Cash, Conta Simples, Tempest, Fanatee, and QuintoAndar.
